items.title: Tigers in tough group with England, SA, SL, NZ
items.summary: The tournament, co-hosted by South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia, will feature 14 teams. 10 teams have come directly by virtue of rankings and hosts.

items.title: Afghanistan announce all-format squads for Bangladesh, Zimbabwe series
items.summary: Afghanistan will first play a one-off Test against Bangladesh from October 9 to 13 in Abu Dhabi, with Rashid missing.

items.title: Litton rues lack of preparation after Pakistan defeat
items.summary: Bangladesh captain Litton Das blamed the team’s lack of preparation and unfamiliarity with the wicket after their six-wicket defeat to Pakistan in the Asian Games semi-final in Nagoya yesterday, a result that ended their hopes of winning gold.

items.title: No gold this time either as Pakistan knock out Tigers
items.summary: The Tigers, who last won gold at the 2010 Asian Games, were restricted to 111-7 after Pakistan elected to field in the rain-curtailed 13-over-a-side contest.

items.title: Uncapped Biswas, Habiba in Nigar Sultana-led Bangladesh squad for Australia ODIs
items.summary: Nigar had stepped down from T20I captaincy after the Asian Games but the board remains confident in her leadership abilities

items.title: Bangladesh and Pakistan hope the sun keeps rising in Nisshin
items.summary: The forecast for semi-finals day in Nisshin is excellent; if that changes and there is no play, Pakistan will enter the final by virtue of their higher seeding

items.title: Molineux, Hamilton out of Bangladesh ODIs; McGrath to captain
items.summary: Molineux is battling a hip injury while Hamilton has a minor quad strain with both hoping to be fit for the New Zealand T20Is

items.title: Pakistan meet Bangladesh, India meet Sri Lanka in Asian Games men's semi-finals
items.summary: All four semi-finalists are yet to contest a ball in the tournament so far

items.title: Bangladesh to take on Pakistan in semis after another washout
items.summary: Bangladesh went through because of their higher seeding compared to Malaysia

items.title: Najmul Hossain Shanto ruled out of Asian Games due to illness
items.summary: He has been suffering from fever since his arrival in Nagoya for men's cricket competition

items.title: Malaysia face Bangladesh in Asian Games quarter-final repeat from 2023
items.summary: The last time these two teams met, Malaysia fell just two runs short

items.title: Molineux a doubt for Bangladesh ODIs with hip injury
